title: Inbox
subtitle: What needs a decision?

headline.open: A few things are ready for you

supporting.clear: Your queue is clear. Keep the good rhythm going.
supporting.open: A quick look now can keep the household moving.
supporting.archived: A quiet record of decisions already made.

meta.open: {count, plural, one {# item to review} other {# items to review}}

activeJarOnlyHint: Only Active jars are allocation targets. Paused and archived stay out.
resolveMoneySafeBody: This only links the existing transaction to a jar. No income, expense, or transfer is created.
amountContextBody: The amount comes from Money or Savings. Inbox does not edit balances.
emptyOpenBody: Nothing is waiting for review right now. This does not mean finances are complete.
receiptJarBody: Jar association updated on the existing transaction. Real money unchanged.
receiptSavingsBody: Inbox closed the review. Any settle or renew ran through Savings — not as an Inbox payment.
receiptAttentionBody: The review item left the queue. Source records were not deleted.
maturitySourceBody: Confirm, switch, or withdraw runs through Savings actions. Inbox only ends the review.
earlyWithdrawalSourceBody: Confirm or cancel uses the Savings early-withdrawal path. Inbox does not invent a transfer.
dismissConfirmBody: It leaves the queue without assigning a jar. You can still find the transaction in Money.
maturityHint: Choose how to continue — Savings performs any money outcome; Inbox only records the decision.

maturityWarnings.package_unavailable: Preferred package is no longer available.
maturityWarnings.rate_changed: Current package rate differs from the locked rate.

earlyWithdrawalHint: Confirm to close the saving via Savings, or keep the saving. Inbox does not create a separate payment.
emiHint: This loan is fully paid. Celebrate or come back later.

why.unmapped_expense: This expense has no jar yet. Pick an Active jar to place it.
why.income_suggest: Income is waiting for Suggest placement into Active jars.
why.savings_maturity: A savings product is at maturity. Choose renew, switch, or withdraw.
why.early_withdrawal_confirmation: Confirm early withdrawal and accept the penalty.
why.emi_complete: A loan is fully paid. Acknowledge the milestone.
why.emergency_declaration: A partner declared an emergency jar reallocation. Review the intent note.
why.loan_payment_attention: A loan payment is due soon or overdue. Open the loan to review the canonical payment state.
why.debt_payment_attention: A debt is due soon or overdue. Open the debt to review the canonical due state.

emergencyHint: A household partner declared an emergency reallocation. Dismiss after you have seen it.
paymentReminderHint: Mark handled by dismissing when the payment is done.
paymentReminderHintWithExpiry: Expires after grace period ({expiresAt}). Dismiss when paid.
patternSuggestionBody: Pre-filled from merchant/pattern history ({confidence}% confidence; auto-resolve at {threshold}%).
archivedEmptyBody: Expired, auto-resolved, and completed items will appear here.
filterEmptyBody: Try another filter or clear the search.
pendingSectionBody: Start with the item that can keep money or plans moving.
historySectionBody: A calm record of decisions already made.
partnerEqualNote: Any partner can resolve — daily Inbox rights are equal.
ownerUnavailableBody: This action belongs to a former household member and can no longer be completed.
ownerRequiredBody: This personal financial item belongs to another household member. You can view it, but only the owner can act.
sourceUnavailableBody: The linked financial source is unavailable, so this item is read-only.
offlineBody: Inbox decisions need a connection. Nothing was saved.
loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
noJarsBody: Unarchive or create a jar in Plan before you can assign these items.
notFoundBody: It may already be resolved, or the link is stale.

errors.inbox_invalid_action: That Inbox action is not valid for this item.
errors.inbox_auto_resolve_not_eligible: This item is not eligible for automatic resolution.
errors.inbox_stale_item: This Inbox item is stale and cannot be changed.
errors.inbox_permission_denied: You do not have permission to change this Inbox item.
errors.inbox_removed_kind: This Inbox type is no longer supported.
errors.inbox_invalid_source_type: This Inbox source is not valid for this item type.
errors.inbox_invalid_assignee: The assigned member is not valid for this household.
errors.inbox_missing_context: This Inbox item is missing required details.
